images.name: the-work
images.title: The *five parts* of the job
steps: Refunds, pay changes, replies to upset customers. Approve, edit or reject each one.
Everything early on. A sample plus anything flagged once it's settled.
Requests outside its instructions. A slow answer is a customer waiting.
A named owner for the price list, policies and booking rules.
Write the new instruction in plain English, test it on past requests, then let it go live.

rows: Clears the approval queue: two lease questions, one refund

images.name: quote
images.text: The right manager is whoever would have managed a person in the same seat. *Judgment about the work belongs with whoever owns the work.*
